place_fields.summary: Hutridurga is a fortified hill with gateways, temples, fort remains and summit views.
place_fields.best_time: September to February; avoid wet or very hot conditions.

planning_attributes.description: Historic hill fort near Huthridurga village with a summit temple and fortification remains.
planning_attributes.elevation_or_height: About 4,000 ft; reported summit elevations vary.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: Traditionally attributed to Kempegowda; later used as a military bastion in the Tipu Sultan period.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Road access via Huthridurga village; Tumakuru is the nearest major rail connection.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: No reliable current official restriction schedule found.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Rocky summit trek; use suitable footwear and caution on wet or exposed sections.
